procedural_matters: Milam Hajek coach of CZE 226723 attended the hearing as an observer.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
ITA 225413 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 8 - 10 knots of wind and small chops.
CZE 226723 was sailing close-hauled on starboard tack on beat to windward.
ITA 225413 was sailing on port tack on a converging course to CZE 225413.
At a distance of 75 cm CZE 226723 dropped his sail and luffed.
There was contact between the bow of CZE 226723 and the middle of the starboard side of ITA 225413.
The contact created a damage in a form of one centimetre long scratch.
conclusions: ITA 225413 on port tack failed to keep clear of CZE 226723 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
ITA 225413 did not avoid contact with CZE 226723 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for CZE 226723 the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with ITA 225413 when it became clear that ITA 225413 was not keeping clear. CZE 226723 did not break RRS 14(a).
decision: ITA 225413 is DSQ in race F1 Silver Fleet.
